reglages.introProprio: This server's backup, and everything that applies to the whole instance: monitoring, restarts, bot statuses, updates, logs, scheduled tasks, gacha catalogue, Cattery access, public mirror.
reglages.introAdmin: What does not belong to a module: this server's backup.

deploy.aide: Triggers a /maj (git pull + rebuild) on the server.
deploy.modeRapideAide: Fast: only the bot container is targeted, and it is recreated only if the image changed. An update with no changes therefore does not interrupt the bot.
deploy.modeCompletAide: Full: every container is recreated, the bot restarts for certain. Keep this when you suspect the Docker cache.
deploy.rafraichirBranches: Ask the repository for the branch list again
deploy.echecBranches: ❌ Failed: bot unreachable or insufficient permissions.
deploy.branchesMuettes: ⚠️ The server did not answer: is the updater installed and running on the VPS? The list shown is the previous one.
deploy.injoignable: ⏳ The bot has stopped answering — that is expected, it is restarting. Reconnecting…
deploy.attenteLog: Waiting for the updater's first lines…
deploy.branchesLues: {n} branch(es) read from the repository on {date}.
deploy.branchesJamais: Branches never fetched: this is the bot's fallback list (DEPLOY_BRANCHES). Click 🔄 to read the repository's.

tasks.aide: What the scheduler actually runs. Since an invalid cron expression is ignored silently, a task missing from this list is not running — even if its configuration says otherwise.

gacha.aide: The import refreshes characters from AniList. It takes several minutes and affects every server: the catalogue is shared.
gacha.lance: ✅ Import started. Follow it in the bot's logs.
gacha.cronInvalide: ❌ Invalid cron expression. Example: 0 4 1 * * (the 1st of the month at 4am).

presence.aide: The little line shown under the bot's name — “stares into the void”, “climbs the curtains”. One status per line; the bot picks one at random at every start-up. There is only one at a time, and it applies to every server.
presence.placeholder:
meow meow
stares into the void
climbs the curtains
presence.tropDeLignes: Past {max}, the extra lines are ignored.
presence.lignesTropLongues: {n} line(s) too long: they will be cut.
presence.echec: ❌ Failed: bot unreachable or insufficient permissions.

restart.aide: The bot shuts down cleanly on the cron expression below (bot time), and its supervisor brings it back — restart: unless-stopped under Docker, the systemd unit or pm2 otherwise. Started by hand in a terminal, it would stay down.
restart.confirmer: Restart the bot now? It will be unreachable for a few seconds.
restart.lance: 🔄 Restart started. The bot is back in a handful of seconds.
restart.cronInvalide: ❌ Invalid cron expression. Example: 0 5 * * * (every day at 5am).
restart.limite: ⏳ Too many requests in a row. Try again in a minute.
restart.incoherent: ⚠️ Enabled, but no task is scheduled: the scheduler did not understand the expression.
restart.etat: {etat} Up for {duree} — last restart requested from here: {date}

logs.aide: Tick the levels you want, pick a day and search for a module or an error message. “Now” reads the bot's memory; a date reads the archive on disk, which survives restarts.
logs.recherche: Search a module or an error…
logs.archiveDesactivee: Archive disabled: only the latest lines in memory are readable, and they are wiped at every restart.
logs.plancher: — archive limited to level {niveau} and above
logs.memoireVive: “Now” view: live memory, wiped at restart.

wishlist.aide: How many characters a member can wish for at once. The list being global — it applies across every server — so is its limit.
wishlist.minimum: A number of at least 1 is required.
wishlist.echec: Failed: bot unreachable or insufficient permissions.
wishlist.fixe: Limit set to {n} wishes per member.

chatterie.restreint: The game is open only on the servers listed below.
chatterie.libre: No restriction: the game is open on every server. Allowing one server closes it everywhere else.
chatterie.pasIci: {nom} is not on it: the game is closed there.
chatterie.echec: Failed: bot unreachable or insufficient permissions.
chatterie.videe: List emptied: the game is open everywhere again.
chatterie.remiseAide: Erases {nom}'s games: purrs, generators, upgrades, achievements, kibble and tree. Irreversible, and with no effect on other servers. Everyone starts from a fresh cattery, portal countdown included.
chatterie.confirmerEffacer: Confirm: erase everything on this server

backup.indisponible: Unavailable: the bot did not answer, or its version predates full backups.
backup.aide: A backup contains everything the bot holds about this server: the modules' configuration, the structure (channels and roles) it references, and the members' data — money, items and inventories, auction house, Endless Road, levels, sanctions, suggestions, giveaways…
backup.autoAide: The bot backs up on its own, on the cron expression below (bot time).
backup.salonCopie: Drop a copy in a channel
backup.salonAide: A backup that lives only next to the database it protects does not protect much: dropping it in a channel leaves you a copy off the bot's server.
backup.aucune: No backup yet. Run one, or enable automatic backups.
backup.avertissementRestauration: Restoring replaces this server's configuration{donnees} with the file's. The current rows will be lost.
backup.horsSauvegarde: Deliberately left out: the /rollback cache (a copy of every message seen, huge and pointless once restored) and temporary voice channels.
backup.restaureeFichier: ✅ Server restored from the file: {modules} module(s){donnees}.
backup.fichierTropGros: ❌ File too large for the dashboard. Use /sauvegarde importer on Discord, or upload the .json.gz version.

erreurs.invalid_cron: ❌ Invalid cron expression. Example: 0 4 * * * (every day at 4am).
erreurs.rate_limited: ⏳ Too many requests in a row. Try again in a minute.
erreurs.forbidden: ❌ You do not have permissions on this server.
erreurs.unknown_guild: ❌ The bot is not (or no longer) on this server.
erreurs.invalid_file: ❌ This file is not a valid Vakz-Bot backup.
erreurs.restore_failed: ❌ The restore failed: nothing was changed.

syncPublic.injoignable: The bot is unreachable: the feature list cannot be read.
syncPublic.titre: What goes out to the public mirrors
syncPublic.aide: Publishing copies a private repository's current state as a single commit, without its history. An unticked feature is removed from both repositories: its folder on the bot side, its pages on the dashboard side.
syncPublic.aideHote: The host builds the result before pushing and aborts if it does not compile. The dry run does everything but the git push.
syncPublic.coreBound: The bot's core imports it directly: excluding it breaks the public repository's build.
syncPublic.orphelins: Still published and depending on it: {liste}.
syncPublic.rienCoteSite: Nothing to remove on the dashboard side.
syncPublic.toujoursExcluAide: Set on the machine hosting the bot, not here: what must never get out is not entrusted to a list editable from a browser. To change it, ALWAYS_EXCLUDES in the vakzbot-sync.service unit.
syncPublic.autresCheminsAide: One per line, relative to that repository's root. * and ? are wildcards. Example: {exemple}
syncPublic.cheminsRefusesAide: A path cannot start with “-” or “/”, contain “..” or a space, or target .git. On the other hand * and ? are wildcards — docs/*.md works.
syncPublic.exclusionsCassantes: These exclusions will most likely break the build
syncPublic.exclusionsCassantesAide: Publishing will be aborted by the host at build time. Run a dry run to check without risking anything.
syncPublic.ceQuiSeraitRetire: What would be removed ({bot} on the bot side, {site} on the dashboard side)
syncPublic.ceQuiSeraitRetireAide: Features resolved into real paths. One tick often means several files — schema and migrations included.
syncPublic.messageCommitAide: Becomes the subject of the published commit. The automatic line — date and originating private commit — goes underneath: it is the only link between the two histories, and it is never lost.
syncPublic.messageCommitExemple: Remove the Cattery from the public mirrors
syncPublic.avertissementPublication: Publishing is final: the public repository is readable by everyone, and forks realign on it every night.
syncPublic.nonEnregistre: Unsaved changes. Publishing reads the list as stored in the database — save first, otherwise what you see here will not be applied.
syncPublic.echecEnregistrement: The bot is unreachable: the list was not saved.
syncPublic.repetitionDemandee: Dry run ({depot}) requested: nothing will be pushed.
syncPublic.demandeRefusee: Request refused (host unreachable, or a publish is already running).
syncPublic.rienAPublier: The mirror was already up to date: nothing to publish. That is why there is neither a log nor a file list — the work stops before the build when there is no difference.

monitoring.seRemplira: The panel fills up as soon as the bot answers again.
monitoring.injoignable: Bot unreachable: no measurement to show.
monitoring.figees: Bot unreachable: measurements frozen at the last read.
monitoring.aide: The instance's state, all servers together: what the process consumes, what Discord answers, what the bot runs. Counters apply to the displayed period; gauges, to the present moment.
monitoring.historiqueEnBase: History kept {jours} day(s) in the database: it survives bot restarts. {mesures} measurements stored{depuis}.
monitoring.historiqueMemoire: History in memory only: a rolling hour, lost at every bot restart. To keep it, set METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS on the bot.
monitoring.tronquee: Period too busy to be drawn in full: only its last stretch is shown. The beginning is missing, not empty.

topCommandes.aide: Totals over the instance's whole life — kept across restarts — with the average run time and the failures.

logs.aide: Over the displayed period, all modules together. The detail is in the Logs tab.
